name: Eric
source: Jon's best friend, is the sole heir of his family's company specializing on caretaker/nurse robots. Is the first person to take care of Jon after his suicide attempt. Is generally a cheerful, inappropriate ladies man. Like Jon he is the black sheep of the family for lacking the ability to heal other people (a mutation power, common in his family). He does have the ability to heal himself instantly though, even growing a new body if his head is cut off. Thus gaining the name 'cockroach'. His P.E.T is a cockroach.
